title: Expressive Words
summary: Given a string s and an array of query strings words, determine how many of these query strings can be transformed into s by applying the extension operation to groups of identical characters.
statement: Given a string s and an array of query strings words, determine how many of these query strings can be transformed into s by applying the extension operation to groups of identical characters. The extension operation involves adding characters to a group of identical characters so that the group's length is three or more.
constraints: Letters may be extended only when the target group has length at least three.
Count words that can become s by extending existing groups.
hints: Run characters must align, and only a target run of at least three may absorb extra copies.
Run-length encode target and candidate words.
Require equal group characters and either equal counts or target>=3 and source<target.
Groups cannot cross character boundaries, making these local conditions necessary and sufficient.
editorial: Groups cannot cross character boundaries, making these local conditions necessary and sufficient.

tests.explanation: Only hello has matching groups and legal target group lengths.
All three words can extend their z and y groups to length five.
